stories.headline: Bitcoin Core Details Three Fixed Security Flaws
stories.summary: October 2025 updates fixed two medium severity flaws and a severe issue that could stop mining node block production.
stories.originalTitle: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security bugs

stories.headline: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for European institutions
stories.summary: The service holds Bitcoin, Ether, and three stablecoins, while establishing a tokenization agreement with Deutsche Asset Management.
stories.originalTitle: Deutsche Bank starts crypto custody for institutional clients

stories.headline: MSCI to Remove Strategy, Metaplanet, and Upexi From Indexes
stories.summary: The index provider will implement these changes following the market close on November 30.
stories.originalTitle: MSCI deletes Strategy from indexes at November close

stories.headline: Anthropic Begins Nasdaq IPO Roadshow at $70 to $78
stories.summary: The firm offers 825 million shares under ticker ANT, targeting a fully diluted valuation up to $1.4 trillion.
stories.originalTitle: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow with $70 to $78 price range on Nasdaq

stories.headline: Major Banks Commit $270 Million to Project Faro
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs, Citi, Santander, and Deutsche Bank are funding a joint US dollar stablecoin initiative.
stories.originalTitle: Banks commit $270 million to Project Faro stablecoin venture

stories.headline: Poland's Sejm Passes Bill to Freeze Crypto Assets
stories.summary: Following a 240-202 vote, the legislation classifying digital assets as freezable funds moves to the Senate.
stories.originalTitle: Poland's Lower House Passes Sanctions Bill With Crypto Freezes

stories.headline: Bitmine Reports $6.3 Billion Net Loss for Fiscal 2026
stories.summary: The corporate ether holder's filing reported internal control weaknesses and holdings valued $5.4 billion below cost.
stories.originalTitle: Bitmine posts $6.3 billion net loss for fiscal 2026 as ether fell

stories.headline: Kalshi Ends Donald Trump Jr. Advisory Contract
stories.summary: The mutual split followed his venture firm's expanded investment in rival prediction market Polymarket.
stories.originalTitle: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.'s advisory role over Polymarket investment

stories.headline: Payward Reports 66% Drop in Q3 Adjusted EBITDA
stories.summary: Lower trading volumes reduced earnings, even as Payward grew non-trading income and expanded spot market share to 6.5%.
stories.originalTitle: Kraken parent Payward posts 66% drop in Q3 adjusted EBITDA

stories.headline: Judge rules Novig sports contracts are not financial swaps
stories.summary: A federal court denied Novig's request to avoid state gambling regulations for its sports event prediction contracts.
stories.originalTitle: New York judge denies Novig injunction, rules sports event contracts are not swaps

stories.headline: Nvidia Board Contacts Arm CEO Rene Haas for Succession
stories.summary: Reports indicate the board contacted Haas as over 1,600 employees called for Jensen Huang to return.
stories.originalTitle: Nvidia board approaches Arm chief Rene Haas as Huang successor

stories.headline: OKXICE to launch tokenized stock trading on November 23
stories.summary: The platform will offer 70 assets for 24/7 trading despite opposition from 67 stock issuers.
stories.originalTitle: OKXICE sets Nov. 23 open for tokenized stock trading

stories.headline: SEC supports CFTC approval of single-stock perpetual futures
stories.summary: The SEC filed a brief supporting the CFTC against a lawsuit from Cboe and Citadel Securities.
stories.originalTitle: SEC backs CFTC in court fight over single-stock perpetual futures

stories.headline: Trump nominates four individuals to SEC and CFTC seats
stories.summary: The president submitted two Republican and two Democratic nominees to the Senate for regulatory commission vacancies.
stories.originalTitle: Trump nominates Peirce successor and three others to SEC, CFTC

stories.headline: Twenty One Capital reports $1.09 billion Q3 profit from Bitcoin
stories.summary: Quarterly earnings came from Bitcoin price appreciation, following a $186.5 million loss during the first nine months.
stories.originalTitle: Twenty One Capital reports $1.09 billion Q3 net income from bitcoin gains
